name: real_pilot
description: Pilot of real, licensed long-form spoken content (podcast/interview transcripts published by their creators) for human-grounded validation of transcript-based quality assessment. Contains no quality labels; labels come from blind human annotation.

selection.procedure: seeded shuffle per group, first eligible items up to quota (avd.datasets.pilot)

changelog.attribution: Transcript © Changelog Media LLC, CC BY-SA 4.0, via github.com/thechangelog/transcripts
changelog.authorization_basis: Publisher-distributed transcript under CC BY-SA 4.0 (repository README 'License & Copyright'); obtained from the publisher's own repository at a pinned commit
changelog.permitted_storage: indefinite, with attribution; adaptations of the text must be CC BY-SA
changelog.revocation_policy: CC licences are irrevocable for obtained copies; honour publisher takedown requests by revoking the content source and withdrawing derived evaluations
changelog.legal_review_notes: Evaluations are treated as analysis, not adaptations of the text; confirm with counsel.

talkpython.attribution: Transcript © Talk Python To Me (Michael Kennedy), GPL-3.0, via github.com/mikeckennedy/talk-python-transcripts
talkpython.authorization_basis: Creator-published transcripts (repository LICENSE GPL-3.0; README: 'Feel free to use the files to help you explore the conversations!'); obtained from the creator's repository at a pinned commit
talkpython.permitted_storage: indefinite; redistribution of the text itself must remain GPL-3.0
talkpython.revocation_policy: Honour creator takedown requests by revoking the content source and withdrawing evaluations
talkpython.legal_review_notes: GPL on prose transcripts is unusual; confirm the analysis use with counsel.
